import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong features by mean difference and t-test
    strong_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if abs(feats.x[:, i].mean() * 2 - 1) > 0.1:  # significant change in mean
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
            if abs(t_stat) > 4 and p_val < 0.001:
                strong_features.append((fid, abs(t_stat)))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic magnitude
    strong_features.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates for drivers (limit to 4 to keep model small)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _ in strong_features[:4]]
    
    # Use only top 3 drivers as columns to keep it small
    columns = drivers[:3] if drivers else []
    
    # No product terms to keep model small
    products = ()
    
    # Create simple loadings (correlation with outcome)
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        loadings[fid] = np.abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col_idx], feats.y)[0, 1])
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
